scope: Fresh source-bound run003; full 16-coordinate W94 stationary 25 C integration fixture. No campaign promotion, M23 qualification, original remote study reproduction, statistical coverage or uniform approximation certificate.

r1_disposition.HARNESS-R1-1: closed: both compiled helper C sources are hashed before build and fixture creation, included in final verify_sources, and present with matching identities in canonical and independent registrations. Both helper files include only math.h and stddef.h; their build options are in bound Python builders.

accepted_observations: public_registration exposes only config, prior_mean, prior_root and center; the perturbed synthetic generator is consumed only by observation synthesis. Both original public starts and the original prior are unchanged.

Distinct-bank and Taylor compressed objectives use one original prior and one joint QR voltage likelihood. Direct Exact consumes the observations once per objective evaluation. Re-evaluation is optimization of the same likelihood, not addition of posterior evidence.

All three arms preserve complete 16-coordinate coupling. Q/SOC local readouts use full fitted roots and analytic endpoint transport, including Q/SOC covariance. Numerical convergence is separate from local provisional curvature and identification.

The joint_relative_jacobian_norm is the spectral norm of the prior-scaled whitened Jacobian defect right-normalized by the direct full-prior QR root. It is a finite same-anchor diagnostic. Endpoint chart maximum and endpoint prior-scaled Jacobian maximum have distinct explicit labels; no uniform or statistical certificate is inferred.

Six meaningful tests independently check exact-node post-step response/transport, residual/score/full-precision parity, all-coordinate directional finite differences, chronology/chunking, source/order/invalid-row rejection and QR failure transaction safety, and map/resource diagnostics.

Runner source hashes precede build/fixture, and the map/public registration identities are also captured before consumption and checked before final result writing. Direct native compilation uses a source snapshot and a separate build receipt; every snapshot identity matches its recorded direct-build source identity.

Report values for all fitted Q/SOC readouts and finite voltage maxima agree with canonical result. W94, 35720 B packed factor, 936 B live response and additional memory exclusions are explicit; this overbudget reference is not promoted.
Synchronous caller-provided source and sequence ownership does not claim authenticated intra-batch provenance, concurrency, asynchronous crash recovery or campaign checkpoint compatibility.
